info.title: Skillbytes API
info.description: Complete REST API for Skillbytes Learning Management System - includes PBL, Assessments, Tracking, and SPK modules

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all available assessments

post.description: Create a new assessment with title, description, time limit, and assessment level. This endpoint is used to add a new assessment to the system for admin and guru roles.

mata_pelajaran_id.description: Mata pelajaran ID - the assessment will be grouped under this subject

kelas_id.description: Kelas ID - the assessment will be grouped under this class

400.description: Validation error or slug already exists

put.description: Update an existing assessment including slug, title, description, time limit, and assessment level. This endpoint modifies assessment details for admin and guru roles.

mata_pelajaran_id.description: Mata pelajaran ID - the assessment will be grouped under this subject

kelas_id.description: Kelas ID - the assessment will be grouped under this class

delete.description: Delete an assessment permanently including all related questions and options. This endpoint removes the assessment from the system for admin and guru roles.

get.description: Retrieve all sections for a specific case

post.description: Create a new section for a case

403.description: Forbidden - Only Admin and Guru can create sections
Forbidden - Only Admin and Guru can update sections
Forbidden - Only Admin and Guru can delete sections

post.description: Create a new item in a section

403.description: Forbidden - Only Admin and Guru can create items
Forbidden - Only Admin and Guru can update items
Forbidden - Only Admin and Guru can delete items

post.description: Upload any file format for lessons/materi (resume, document, etc.). Only accessible to Admin and Guru roles. Max size: 100MB

403.description: Forbidden - Only Admin and Guru can upload files

post.description: Upload an image for PBL cases or section items. Only accessible to Admin and Guru roles.

403.description: Forbidden - Only Admin and Guru can upload images

post.summary: Create multiple options in bulk for question
post.description: Add multiple option/answer choices to a question in a single request. This bulk endpoint allows creating up to 1000 options at once for admin and guru roles. At least one option must be marked as the correct answer.

label.description: Option label (A, B, C, D, etc.)

put.description: Update an existing option including label, text, and correct answer flag. This endpoint modifies option details for admin and guru roles.

delete.description: Delete an option from a question. This endpoint removes the answer choice from the system for admin and guru roles.

get.description: Retrieve all available PBL cases with current user's status

post.summary: Create a new PBL case (Admin/Guru only)
post.description: Create a new PBL case with all details. Only accessible to Admin and Guru roles.

403.description: Forbidden - Only Admin and Guru can create cases

get.description: Retrieve full details of a specific PBL case including all sections and items

put.description: Update an existing PBL case. Only accessible to Admin and Guru roles.

403.description: Forbidden - Only Admin and Guru can update cases

delete.description: Delete an existing PBL case. Only accessible to Admin and Guru roles.

403.description: Forbidden - Only Admin and Guru can delete cases

post.summary: Create multiple questions in bulk for assessment
post.description: Add multiple questions to an assessment in a single request. This bulk endpoint allows creating up to 1000 questions at once. Supports file upload for question images.

questions[0][text].example: What is the capital of France?

questions[0][explanation].example: France is located in Western Europe.

questions[0][image].description: Question image file (optional, max 5MB, formats: jpeg, png, jpg, gif)

put.description: Update an existing question including text, explanation, and image file. Supports image file upload.

requestBody.description: Updated question data with optional image

text.example: What is the capital of Germany?

image.description: Updated question image file (optional, max 5MB, formats: jpeg, png, jpg, gif)

delete.description: Delete a question including all its options and related answers. This endpoint removes the question from the system for admin and guru roles.

get.summary: Get students at risk that need attention

parameters.name: risk_level
parameters.description: Filter by risk level (critical, high, medium, low)

get.summary: Get subject mastery statistics across all students
Get detailed risk profile for a specific student

get.description: Retrieve assessment results. Users see only their own results, admins/gurus see all results with pagination.
Retrieve detailed result of a specific assessment attempt. Users can only view their own results, admins/gurus can view any result.

get.summary: Get assessments filtered by mata pelajaran

200.description: List of assessments filtered by mata pelajaran

get.description: Retrieve detailed assessment with all questions and options. Note: is_correct field is NOT included to prevent answer leakage.

post.description: Begin taking an assessment. Only one active attempt allowed per assessment per user.
Submit user's answer(s). Supports both single and bulk submissions. Each question can only be answered once. Cannot answer after completion or timeout.

400.description: Question already answered or attempt not in progress

post.summary: Complete assessment and get final score
post.description: Finalize the assessment attempt. Calculates score automatically.

400.description: Attempt timed out or not in progress

get.description: Retrieve all PBL case submissions from all students. Only administrators and teachers (guru) can access this endpoint. Results are paginated (15 items per page) and sorted by submission date (newest first).

200.description: List of all submissions successfully retrieved (paginated, 15 per page, sorted by submitted_at DESC)

403.description: Forbidden - only admin and guru can view all submissions

401.description: Unauthenticated - no valid bearer token provided

post.summary: Submit answer for a PBL case
post.description: Submit an answer to a PBL case with optional text and/or file upload. Students can only submit once per case. Both text answer and file submission are optional but at least one must be provided.

requestBody.description: Case submission with answer text and/or file

case_id.description: The PBL case ID to submit answer for

answer.example: This is my detailed answer to the case...

submission_file.description: Submission file (any format accepted - PDF, DOC, images, etc.)

400.description: Validation failed - already submitted or case not available

get.description: Retrieve all PBL case submissions belonging to the currently authenticated user.

put.description: Assign a score (0-100) and provide feedback to a student's PBL case submission. Only administrators and teachers (guru) can perform this action.

requestBody.description: Grading data with score and feedback

score.description: Numerical score from 0 to 100 (with decimals supported)

feedback.description: Feedback message for the student (minimum 5 characters)
feedback.example: Good analysis of the case. Consider discussing alternative approaches.

403.description: Forbidden - only administrators and teachers can grade submissions

422.description: Validation error - invalid score or feedback format

get.summary: [DEBUG] Get all my submissions without pagination
get.description: DEBUG ENDPOINT ONLY - Retrieve raw unfiltered list of all submissions for the current user without pagination. Useful for debugging data availability issues. Shows submission count stats.

200.description: All submissions for current user (unfiltered, no pagination)

all_submissions.description: All submissions belonging to the current user (unfiltered)

get.summary: List PBL cases by mata pelajaran
get.description: Retrieve paginated PBL cases filtered by mata pelajaran ID

200.description: List of PBL cases filtered by mata pelajaran

get.summary: Get summary of strengths and weaknesses
Get daily learning time breakdown for charting

post.description: Create a new user account. Default role is 'siswa' (student).
Authenticate user with email and password. Returns user data and bearer token.
Logout current user and invalidate the authentication token.

get.description: Retrieve paginated list of Kelas for the authenticated user

post.description: Create a new Kelas (Admin/Guru only)

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific Kelas

put.description: Update details of an existing Kelas (Admin/Guru only)

post.description: Add a student to a specific Kelas (Admin/Guru only)

delete.description: Remove a student from a specific Kelas (Admin/Guru only)

get.description: Retrieve all Lesson/Materi assigned to a specific Kelas
Retrieve all Tugas/PBL Cases assigned to a specific Kelas
Retrieve all Ujian/Assessments assigned to a specific Kelas
Retrieve paginated list of lessons for authenticated user.

post.description: Create a new lesson. Only accessible to admin and guru roles. Use POST /lessons/{slug}/upload-file to upload lesson materials after creation.

get.description: Retrieve all available lessons for authenticated user without pagination.
Retrieve detailed lesson information by slug.

post.description: Update an existing lesson. Only accessible to admin and guru roles. Use POST /lessons/{slug}/upload-file to upload/update lesson materials.

delete.description: Delete a lesson permanently. Only accessible to admin and guru roles.

get.description: Retrieve all lessons for a specific mata pelajaran (subject).

message.example: Lessons by mata pelajaran retrieved successfully

get.description: Retrieve all lessons completed by the authenticated user.

put.summary: Update or add resume for a lesson
put.description: Update or add resume text for a lesson. Resume must contain at least 300 words. Only accessible to admin and guru roles.

resume.example: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo consequat. Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse cillum dolore eu fugiat nulla pariatur. Excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat non proident, sunt in culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum.

400.description: Validation error - Resume must be at least 300 words

post.summary: Upload or update file for a lesson
post.description: Upload or update a file for a lesson. Accepts any file format (PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT, XLS, ZIP, etc). Max file size: 100MB. Only accessible to admin and guru roles.

file.description: File to upload (any format - PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT, XLS, ZIP, etc)

400.description: Validation error - File required or too large

get.description: Retrieve paginated list of learning subjects (mata pelajaran).

post.description: Create a new learning subject. Only accessible to admin and guru roles.

get.summary: Get all mata pelajarans with lessons
get.description: Retrieve all learning subjects with their associated lessons.
Retrieve detailed information of a specific mata pelajaran by level number.

put.description: Update an existing learning subject. Only accessible to admin and guru roles.

delete.description: Delete a learning subject permanently. Only accessible to admin and guru roles.

get.description: Retrieve paginated list of users with optional search and sorting. Accessible to all authenticated users.
Retrieve all users without pagination. Only accessible to admin and guru roles.
Retrieve detailed information of a specific user by ID.

post.description: Update user information. Use POST when uploading files/form-data. Supports partial updates via PATCH/PUT with JSON body.

delete.description: Delete a user account permanently. Only accessible to admin and guru roles.

post.description: Create a new user account. Only accessible to admin and guru roles. Supports profile photo upload.

requestBody.description: User data with optional profile photo

put.description: Update user password. Users can only change their own password, while admin can change any user's password.

400.description: Validation error - old password incorrect or new password too short

403.description: Forbidden - only admin or the user themselves can change password

post.description: Mark a lesson as completed for the authenticated user.

get.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's overall progress including completed lessons and mata_pelajarans.
Retrieve all resumes for the authenticated user. Can filter by lesson_id.

post.summary: Create new resume for a lesson
post.description: Create a new resume for the authenticated user for a specific lesson.

lesson_id.description: Lesson ID this resume is for

content.example: This lesson covered data structures including arrays, linked lists...

get.description: Retrieve a specific resume by ID for the authenticated user.

403.description: Forbidden - Resume belongs to another user

put.description: Update the content of an existing resume for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Delete a resume for the authenticated user.
